```{r}
library(reticulate)


# Simple dataset

cohort_size <- 1000  
set.seed(1254)
Z.1 <- rnorm(cohort_size)  
Z.2 <- rnorm(cohort_size)  
Z.3 <- rnorm(cohort_size)  
# randomized treatment
X <- rbinom(cohort_size, 1, 0.5)
# binary outcome variable
Y <- rbinom(cohort_size, 1,  1/(1 + exp(-(-2 + Z.1 + Z.2 + Z.3 + X * Z.1))))
df <- data.frame(Z.1, Z.2, Z.3, X, Y)
```


```{python}
import sys, os
import random
import time

# add the project root to sys.path
# make sure 'frengression.py' is available in the directory
root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "../src"))
if root not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, root)

from frengression import *

device = torch.device('cpu')

import numpy as np
```

```{python}

torch.set_num_threads(20)

num_iters = 100

# cast data into tensor objects
x_tr = torch.tensor(r.df['X'].values, dtype=torch.int32).view(-1, 1)
z_tr = torch.tensor(r.df[['Z.1', 'Z.2', 'Z.3']].values, dtype=torch.float32)
y_tr = torch.tensor(r.df['Y'].values, dtype=torch.int32).view(-1, 1)

# build the frengression model
model = Frengression(x_dim = 1, y_dim = 1, z_dim = 3,
                             noise_dim=1, num_layer=3, hidden_dim=100,
                             device=device, x_binary=True,
                             y_binary=True,
                             z_binary_dims=0)

# train the model
random.seed(10)

start = time.time()
model.train_y(x=x_tr,
              z=z_tr, 
              y=y_tr, 
              num_iters=num_iters, lr=1e-4, print_every_iter=10, tol=0)

model.train_xz(x_tr, z_tr, num_iters=num_iters, lr=1e-4, print_every_iter=10)
end = time.time()

train_time = end - start

print("training time: {f}", train_time)

# generate samples from trained model
sampled_x_5x, sampled_y_5x, sampled_z_5x = model.sample_joint(sample_size=int(r.cohort_size))
```


```{python}

# specifying the causal margin

import torch.distributions as dist

normal = dist.Normal(0., 1.)
class SpecifiedCausalMargin(StoNetBase):
    def __init__(self, ate, noise_dim, eta_dist, x_dim):
        super().__init__(noise_dim=noise_dim)
        self.ate = ate  # or self.register_buffer('eta', torch.tensor(eta))
        self.x_dim = x_dim
        self.eta_dist = eta_dist

    def forward(self, x):
        if x.shape[1]==self.x_dim:
            if self.eta_dist == 'gamma':
                # per‐element alpha, beta
                alpha_arr = torch.full(x.shape, 2.0, device=x.device)
                beta_arr  = torch.full(x.shape, 1.0, device=x.device)
                gamma_dist = torch.distributions.Gamma(alpha_arr, beta_arr)
                eta = gamma_dist.sample()
            if self.eta_dist == 'gaussian':
                eta = torch.randn(x.shape, device=x.device)
            if self.eta_dist == 'laplace':
                lap  = dist.Laplace(0, 0.5)
                eta  = lap.sample(x.shape,device=x.device)
            if self.eta_dist == 'lognormal':
                lognorm = dist.LogNormal(0, 1)
                eta     = lognorm.sample(x.shape).to(x.device)
        else:
            x_eta = x.clone()
            x = x_eta[:, :self.x_dim]
            eta_inp = x_eta[:, self.x_dim:]
            if self.eta_dist== 'gaussian':
                eta = eta_inp  
            if self.eta_dist == 'gamma':
                alpha = torch.full_like(eta_inp, 2.0)
                beta  = torch.full_like(eta_inp, 1.0)
                u = dist.Normal(0, 1).cdf(eta_inp)
                u = u.clamp(min=1e-6, max=1 - 1e-6)
                eta = special.gammaincinv(alpha, u) / beta
            if self.eta_dist == 'laplace':
                u = dist.Normal(0, 1).cdf(eta_inp)
                u = u.clamp(min=1e-6, max=1-1e-6)
                eta = torch.where(
                    u < 0.5,
                    0 +  0.5*torch.log(2 * u),
                    0 -  0.5* torch.log(2 * (1 - u))
                )
            if self.eta_dist == 'lognormal':
                u = normal.cdf(eta_inp).clamp(min=1e-6, max=1 - 1e-6)
                z = normal.icdf(u)     # which is exactly eta_inp
                eta = torch.exp(z)

        # other distributions can be implemented likewise
        return self.ate * x + eta
      
margin_module = SpecifiedCausalMargin(ate=5, eta_dist="gaussian", x_dim=model.x_dim, noise_dim=model.noise_dim)
model.specify_causal(causal_margin=margin_module)

# sample new data which follows the specified causal margin

sampled_x_5x, sampled_y_5x, sampled_z_5x = model.sample_joint(sample_size=1000)

```
